facts.fact: TechnoMag states the Act establishes the data protection framework and that licensing under it is mandatory and enforced by notice; dated by publication.

TechnoMag reports POTRAZ issued a notice warning unlicensed organisations processing personal data to comply immediately, noting widespread non-compliance after the 12 March 2025 deadline; no sanction is reported. Dated by publication.
TechnoMag states POTRAZ is the designated Data Protection Authority under section 5 of the Act and issued a notice to unlicensed organisations; dated by publication.
